note.title: Customs, festivals and celebrations
note.specFocus: Customs, special occasions, religious and non-religious festivals, traditions, food, music, family celebrations, public events, and personal opinions.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Customs, festivals and celebrations

Key vocabulary
- la fiesta; la celebración; el desfile; la costumbre; los fuegos artificiales; decorar; celebrar; la Nochevieja; la boda; el cumpleaños; el disfraz; tradicional; típico/a; participar

Key grammar
- Use the present for regular customs, the preterite for one celebration, and the imperfect for background description or childhood traditions. Add comparisons and justified opinions.

Exam tips
- Use se celebra / se come for general customs. Distinguish celebrar (to celebrate) from tener lugar (to take place). Give a cultural detail, not only an opinion.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ve una calle llena de banderines, música y gente con disfraces. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre las costumbres, las fiestas y las celebraciones. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see a street full of bunting, music and people in costumes. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)
questions.question: Describe this photo showing a street full of bunting, music and people in costumes. Explain what the people are doing, make two reasonable inferences and give your own justified opinion about the topic.

questions.modelAnswer:
— En mi ciudad celebramos una feria de primavera cada abril. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) En Nochevieja algunas personas comen doce uvas a medianoche.

(English: — In my town we celebrate a spring fair every April. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — On New Year's Eve some people eat twelve grapes at midnight.)
